data.title: Global fossil fuel emissions to fall 0.4% in 2026 amid US-Iran war | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Global fossil fuel emissions are projected to fall 0.4% in 2026, the first drop since 2020, partly as the Iran war cut oil and gas use. Researchers warn the decline is unlikely to last.
